segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר: כׇּל תְּנַאי שֶׁאֵינוֹ כִּתְנַאי בְּנֵי גָּד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן – אֵינוֹ תְּנַאי. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אִם יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן״. וּכְתִיב: ״וְאִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Meir says: Any condition that is not» doubled, i.e., which does not specify both the result of fulfilling the condition and the result of the condition remaining unfulfilled, «like the condition» Moses stipulated with «the children of Gad and the children of Reuben» who sought to settle on the eastern side of the Jordan, «is not» a valid «condition» and is not taken into account at all. «As it is stated: “And» Moses «said to them, if the children of Gad and the children of Reuben pass over» the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession” (Numbers 32:29). «And it is written» afterward: «“But if they will not pass over armed» with you, they shall receive a possession among you in the land of Canaan” (Numbers 32:30).
